0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak, 0-2 on the road) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak, 1-1 at home) for the Suns' fifth game of the season. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
